title: C TDMA: implement DesyncFSM core states/transitions (spec 09 14.7 R-09-133)
description: Smallest child of b7z9.12. Add the desync recovery FSM to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c + ctx header, mirroring python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:77-125 DesyncFSM and rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:82-150: states SYNCED -> DESYNCED (SFN wrap + invalid time provider), DESYNCED -> RECOVERING (valid beacon ts >= floor matching SFN), RECOVERING -> SYNCED after 3 consecutive valid beacons, RECOVERING -> DESYNCED on timeout/invalid ts; RECOVERING timeout RECOMMENDED 3 superframes (constant + documented). Host-testable state machine (extend the tdma host test if one exists, else tests/routing_dispatch-style standalone or a new lichen/tests dir following test_common.cmake). Python tests python/tests/timing/test_sfn.py:284-297 are the behavioral oracle. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.12.
close_reason: C DesyncFSM landed (commit eda353bf65): enum lichen_desync_state (SYNCED/DESYNCED/RECOVERING) + ctx fields + three entry points (lichen_desync_on_sfn_wrap/on_beacon/on_missed_superframe) in tdma.c, all inside the CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA ifdef. Transitions mirror the Python oracle (timing/sfn.py DesyncFSM) exactly: SYNCED->DESYNCED on SFN wrap with invalid time provider (no-op in other states); DESYNCED->RECOVERING on first valid beacon (count 1); RECOVERING valid beacons increment count (resetting missed-superframes) and 3 consecutive -> SYNCED; invalid beacon in RECOVERING -> DESYNCED (counters reset); bounded RECOVERING listen timeout 3 missed superframes -> DESYNCED (no-op outside RECOVERING). Constants split per review: LICHEN_DESYNC_RECOVERY_BEACONS (recovery threshold) vs LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES (listen timeout, oracle-traceable name) — the two 14.7 parameters no longer share one constant. Host test test_desync_fsm (tdma_guard_budget) pins: init NULL-ctx guard + init-based fixture (not memset), wrap-invalid -> DESYNCED, wrap-valid no-op, valid->RECOVERING count 1, invalid->DESYNCED reset, 3-valid->SYNCED reset, wrap no-op in DESYNCED, NULL guards on all three entry points, valid-beacon-in-RECOVERING resets missed while preserving consecutive count (sfn.py:115-116), timeout 3-missed->DESYNCED, no-op outside RECOVERING. Verification: host build+run all asserts green; ZEPHYR native_sim routing_dispatch build green (header consumed by TDMA-enabled builds). Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3: transitions/counter-resets/NULL-guards/header-placement confirmed defect-free; findings all P4 test-completeness items (constant split, oracle naming, NULL tests, no-op coverage, interleave coverage, init fixture) — ALL six fixed in this commit. Follow-ups: sibling .2 (SFN-wrap/epoch-floor wiring + desync vectors) owns the signal integration.
